title: GS21 2-regime with five exposure types, each a separate solve
question: Do heterogeneous production exposures bend the risk-price map enough to create harvestable room?
notes:
SUPERSEDED BY var-gs_bx-bx7-v3 (2026-09-07) BEFORE IT EVER RAN. The five ids precommitted below are the gs_ashift = 0.15*(gs_bx-1) economy; the decision that same day to set gs_ashift = 0 replaced it. Kept as the record of the ladder and of why it was dropped -- the level compensation was 3.3x the exposure swing it accompanied. The array running on Sol at the time of the decision was solving THIS spec.

PRECOMMITMENT: the five expected_solves below were computed from the current parameters and code WITHOUT solving (the id is a hash of inputs, so it is knowable in advance). They are what the five-task array in run_gs_bx7_slurm.sh must produce. If it produces anything else, the cluster and the laptop disagree on a solve_id and that must be chased before any number from this economy is usable. Clear solves_pending once they are recorded.

Current runnable spec for the bx7 economy. The overrides are unchanged from v1; the economy changed through config.py, which the spec's params cannot express -- which is exactly why expected_solves is recorded, since a solve_id pins the whole parameter namespace. v1's published figures (room +0.0182, gap_RFF-lin +0.0013, t 10.4, rank 22 of 24) came from the uncorrected calibration and must not be quoted for this economy; in particular the demotion of bx7 out of the first production run rests on them.

OPEN, BLOCKING A PANEL RUN: gs_solve_reg.py applies gs_ashift to the payoff tables (line 152) but gs_sim_bx.py omits it in BOTH the simulated cash flow (line 151, `prod`) and the exported op_cash_flow that feeds `roe` (line 229). There is no per-firm ashift array in the simulator at all. For four of the five types the solve assumes productivity exp(gs_ashift) x the simulation's: 1.252, 1.568, 1.964, 2.460. The solves are internally correct; any panel built from them is not. Resolve before running the oracle on this spec.

changes: GS21 base calibration corrected against the paper's Table I on 2026-09-06: delta 0.02 -> 0.02/3, rho_x 0.96 -> 0.95**(1/3), sigma_x rebased on 0.95, kappa_e 0 -> 0.025. v1 ran the uncorrected calibration at an implicit kappa_e = 0.
kappa_e is now actually APPLIED: utils_gs21/panel_functions_gs21.py imported it and never used it.
records expected_solves for all five exposure types.

seeds.policy: run_oracle.py --seed drives BOTH the firm-level shocks (global numpy stream) and the AGGREGATE state path (gam_seed / reg_seed offset by the seed). Seed 0 reproduces the pre-2026-09-07 single-run behaviour; --common_aggregate restores the old fixed-aggregate behaviour as an explicit variance decomposition.
